'''The Wonderbilt''' was one of the finest [[Hotel/Legends|hotels]] in [[Hologram Fun World]]. The hotel was the target of an armed robbery by a group of thugs led by [[Tibor]] the Barabel, who robbed the guests of their jewelry at blaster-point.<ref name="Q">''[[Queen of the Empire]]''</ref>
